```plato
    // Smooth difference over blendRadius; bounds stay those of `a` grown by
    // blendRadius — subtraction only shrinks the solid, but the fillet rounds
    // outward at the lip of the cut. Precondition: blendRadius is positive.
    SmoothDifference(a: BoundedSdf2D, b: BoundedSdf2D, blendRadius: Number): BoundedSdf2D
        => (a.Sdf.SmoothDifference(b.Sdf, blendRadius), GrowBounds(a.Bounds, blendRadius));
```
